wild.line_resolution: enumerate each regular candidate over the consecutive prefix containing only that symbol or ghost_wild, plus the pure ghost_wild prefix; pay one candidate per line by highest base payout, then longest match, then canonical paytable symbol order

feature.name: BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
feature.target_selection: one authoritative regular symbol at feature_start
feature.expansion: before line evaluation, every reel containing the selected target in the original free-spin board becomes three target symbols

deep_access.guarantee: the two canonical guaranteed BREACH positions are present on every opening spin; a third BREACH on another reel triggers the feature

complete_round_cap.application: line awards are applied in ascending payline id order and truncated to the remaining complete-round cap; no later payout or feature event occurs
